verdict.rationale: Docs confirm memory operations are accessible via Python and JavaScript (mem0-docs-25, mem0-docs-35) and an OpenAPI spec exists (mem0-probe-2), implying multi-language SDK support, but there's no explicit dedicated TypeScript SDK documentation or side-by-side API parity evidence, and no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit TypeScript SDK docs, feature-parity comparison between Python/TS clients, independent developer confirmation of consistent APIs.
